validation.native_freshness_regression: passed: static versioned no-GPU polls, stale-positive unversioned, actual named-mutex Busy, demand pulse/lost mailbox, reconnect/resize

limitations: Short unpinned diagnostics do not establish causal timing improvement or prescribed qualification.
Unversioned successful copies may repeat contents and carry unknown producer versions.
Source unchanged counters include bridge-capacity skips; they do not count unique producer frames.
Native regression exercises named mutex; keyed-mutex changes are source-reviewed and compiled, not newly hardware-proven.
Renderer/source/fixture GPU spans are context-local and must not be summed into a critical path.
Consumer captures lack an exact complete renderer-output cohort; API acceptance and software deadlines do not prove scanout.
Editor interruption cadence/age failures, Q02 producer shortfalls and resource/recovery qualification remain open.
